name: oss-issue-proof
description: Windows-only Codex maintenance evidence and verification Skill.

interface.longDescription: Skills-only plugin for supported Windows 10/11 hosts. With a separately installed issue-proof CLI, it guides GitHub-connector intake, canonical argv collection, two-run baseline reproduction, same-identity verification, and redacted draft receipts; Codex JSONL is optional enrichment. Tested with Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.14. Linux and macOS are unsupported, untested, and unverified. It does not post, push, publish, start Codex, or read private Codex state.
defaultPrompt: Collect two baselines, verify the same canonical argv, and draft an IssueProof receipt on Windows.
